env_keys_referenced.note: KEY NAMES ONLY — values live in 1Password (vault EntrepreneurOS), loaded on the Beast via `op run --env-file=.env.op.tpl`. plaintext .env is retired (env_op_tpl_present=yes, env_gitignored=yes, plaintext_env=retired).

modules.what_it_is: Express bootstrap: JSON middleware, API request logging, error handler, Vite dev-server in development / static serve in production, listens on :5000 serving both API and client.
modules.substrate_mapping: none — deployment entrypoint stays app-local on the Beast; UMH equivalent is services/ entrypoints
modules.notes: Runtime host is the Beast (runtime_ready=yes). VPS node role forbids running app bodies.

modules.what_it_is: Monolithic route registration (~2,360 lines): AI model info/generation, agents CRUD + chat, tasks CRUD + collaboration/subtasks, conversations, multi-agent collaboration, stats, analytics, integrations, notifications, AI-assistant messages, CRM (contacts/deals/activities), folders, documents, LLM chat, agent-action approve/reject, Gmail OAuth, agent metrics.
modules.substrate_mapping: read surfaces map to the projection read-surface discipline (projections/eos accessor + thin transport wrapper); write paths map to governed_mutation through transports/api/governed; agent chat/execution maps to the canonical spine
modules.notes: Violates UMH quality standards as-is (god file, direct provider SDK construction, /api/keys/save mutates process.env from an HTTP body). Route semantics are the import target, not the code.

modules.what_it_is: passport-local (scrypt password hashing) + Firebase/Google token auth, express-session with connect-pg-simple store, register/login/logout/user endpoints.
modules.substrate_mapping: conflicts with UMH auth: cockpit uses Clerk (locked to AFM's Clerk ID), UMH HTTP auth lives in transports/api/http/middleware. Reconciling EOS Firebase/passport auth with Clerk is an owner decision.
modules.notes: OWNER DECISION REQUIRED: auth model (Firebase/passport vs Clerk) before any EOS user-facing build-out.

modules.what_it_is: Drizzle ORM over postgres-js using DATABASE_URL (Neon).
modules.substrate_mapping: UMH platform DB client pattern lives in transports/api/http/db; EOS keeps its own Neon database — separate from the UMH platform DB
modules.notes: EOS DATABASE_URL is a distinct Neon instance. Never point it at the UMH platform DB.

modules.what_it_is: IStorage interface + DatabaseStorage implementation over all 15 Drizzle tables; also owns the pg-backed session store. The single data-access seam of the app.
modules.substrate_mapping: the IStorage seam is where a future governed adapter would attach (reads → projection read surfaces; writes → governed_mutation)
modules.notes: Best-understood integration seam in the app body: one interface gates all DB access.

modules.what_it_is: Drizzle schema + zod insert schemas for 15 tables: users, agents, tasks, messages, integrations, notifications, ai_messages, crm_contacts, crm_deals, crm_activities, folders, documents, agent_actions, oauth_tokens, agent_metrics.
modules.substrate_mapping: already mirrored to /opt/OS per node-role discipline (shared/schema.ts is the ONE Trinity file the VPS keeps). Domain concepts map: agents→UMH organism roles (L3 vocabulary), tasks→WorkPacket semantics, agent_actions→governed_mutation approval flow, crm_*→EOS L3 domain (BIS venture/client), oauth_tokens→credential-injection law territory.
modules.notes: SCHEMA CHANGES = CRITICAL risk class. No migration in this packet or without owner approval + row counts.

modules.notes: Name collision flagged for the owner; resolve on the Beast before any messages-table integration.

modules.notes: Import the SEMANTICS (action types, approval flow, retry policy) onto the canonical runtime; never a parallel executor.
